coverage.threshold_rule: At least 3 distinct dated comparable observations spanning at least 90 days from at least 2 independent origins, or a verified continuous price series covering at least 90 days.

limitations: No verified price for the previous Black Friday (2025-11-28) was established; the only fetched in-window price is the Tom's Guide Cyber Monday item dated by article publication (2025-12-01), not a Black Friday-day price.
The Tom's Guide date is the article publication date, not a dated price record; the Amazon listing it refers to is the Grey colourway (ASIN B07FDJMC9Q), so colourway match is uncertain.

Best Buy current price ($79.99 Black Friday deal) was captured on fetch today; the fetched page carries no timestamp, so the observation date is the fetch date and may not reflect the exact time the price was shown.
